messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: PagerBridge is returning 502s on outgoing webhook to PagerDuty. Paging events are being queued locally (queue_length=312). Affecting prod-alerts routing. Investigating — will update.
alex: seeing the backlog in the bridge logs too. looks like PD endpoint started returning 502 at ~1765432000. no automatic retries succeeding.
jane: @ryan are you oncall? did you get any pages? :thinking:
ryan: I did not get any pages. My phone shows nothing and PD web shows no recent incidents. I can try manual ack if someone triggers.
ops-bot: incident-bot attempted to page 12 times since 1765432050, all failed with: ``HTTP 502 Bad Gateway\n{"error":"upstream unavailable","id":"pb-9f2"}``
oncall-sre: Confirming PD API is reachable from other infra? Can we curl PD from the bridge host?
alex: running quick curl from bridge-host, getting 502 as well. ``curl -v https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue`` response included upstream timeout.
jane: hmm PD status page? I can't find an incident. Maybe our egress route to PD is having a proxy issue.
sara: FYI I rotated the oncall in the schedule at 04:00 but the incident-bot config still references the old rotation id. possible cause for missed handoffs.
ryan: that would explain why I didn't see any changes — I should not have been oncall. @jane can you confirm who is currently primary in schedule?
jane: checking... ``/oncall status prod`` returns: ``primary: sara, secondary: ryan`` oh crap, incident-bot config shows primary=ryan. :grimacing:
alex: ok two separate problems: 1) PagerBridge -> PagerDuty 502s (outbound failures). 2) incident-bot rotation config mismatch causing wrong target when it does succeed. We should treat paging as degraded and fallback to manual.
ops-bot: Manual fallback steps (run as infra-admin):
```
# trigger PD incident via CLI if webhook broken
pd incidents create --service "prod-alerts" --title "manual page: prod error surge" --body "bridge outbound 502s; queued events" --urgency high
``` 
I just triggered a manual PD incident and assigned to primary (sara). PD UI shows an incident, ping sent, sara acknowledged at 1765432231.
ryan: acked on my side that sara got it. good.
oncall-sre: quick mitigation: scaled bridge workers to drain queue and enabled 2s retry jitter. Command run: ``kubectl scale deployment/pagerbridge --replicas=6 -n infra``. Monitoring: queue_length dropping from 312 -> 48 in 90s.
jane: for handoff confusion: I'm going to update incident-bot config to reference the schedule id rather than hard-coded user. patch:
```
incident-bot.cfg:
- oncall_user: "ryan"
+ oncall_schedule_id: "sched-prod-v2"
```
I'll roll that in a canary to staging then prod.
alex: customer impact summary so far: elevated 500s for write-api for ~5m window starting 1765432005. Estimated affected requests ~1.2k (0.9% of global traffic). No PII exposed. We should mark as degraded but limited.
jane: creating INC ticket: INC-2026-345 in ops tracker with timeline, attaching logs and PD incident id pd_inc_789. Assigning follow-up to @alex and @sara for root cause (bridge egress + config drift).
sara: will own the RCA and rollout a fix for egress path + test harness for PD chaining. thanks everyone for quick manual fallback. :thumbsup:
monitoring-bot: post-incident checks: will run synthetic PD enqueue every 5m for next 2h and alert if 502 returns. adding alert: pagerbridge.outbound_502 > 0 for 3m.
alex: closing this thread for now, will update INC when RCA draft is ready. timeline: detected 1765432005, manual paging at 1765432230, queue drained by 1765432350. last note: please add a runbook step to verify rotation id mapping after schedule changes."
